name: Fishing Planet: Tricky Treats Pack
summary:
This freaky-licious pack of Halloween holiday treats is just what you need to trick the creepy monsters into biting! We'll even toss in 666 superstition Credits and 13 lucky BaitCoins to add some magic numbers to this brew!

The Tricky Treats Pack includes:
* 13 BAITCOINS use to purchase certain fishing tackle, available only for BaitCoins. Spend your BaitCoins wisely!
* 666 CREDITS use your Credits to purchase new tackle, pay for fishing trips, repairs and any other in-game expenses. Spend your money wisely!

BAITS AND LURES
* Silicon Spider 10 cm (x10)
* Skull Jig 1 1/2 Oz. (42 g), #6/0 (x10)
* Hooks: Hawk Claw; Vulture Claw; Eagle Claw (x10)
* Baits: Dead Mice; Pig's Eye; Rotten Minnows; Frog; Bloodworms; Maggots; Sour Bread; Moldy Cheese; Dried Locusts; Candy (x50)
